answer: Lookalike agents stay cheap unless intake prices payout timing. At a shared canopy grove, each new agent locks 21.8 POA for 36 hours and every 25 minutes emits a 64-byte whisper packet hashed from its last five outbound payments plus a 12-bit salt. A raven perch of six non-kin neighbors recomputes it in about 35ms and signs only if inter-arrival stays under 800ms and no already-signed sibling sits within five hops. Cost is 21.8 POA locked 36 hours plus 0.09s per packet. A reused whisper or five-hop sibling burns 50% of the bond and bars that funding trunk for two epochs.
